first_red.mechanism: The first mutation table used record-relative offsets +18 and +20 for fields 9 and 10 of <HHHHHHHHIHHII>. Their actual offsets are +20 and +22; the initial probes therefore changed slice_build_id and payload_crc while carrying payload_crc and record_crc labels.
first_red.correction: The reusable mutation gate now restores the old payload CRC at record+20 and the old record CRC at record+22, and verify executes all five mutations on every replay.

claim_limit: Mutation-checker correction only; no hardware or product result.
